entities.summary: Anders Arne Bergman was a Swedish ice hockey goaltender who was a member of the Swedish national team at the 1987 Canada Cup and 1988 Winter Olympics, but did not play in either event. He played for Modo and Färjestad throughout his club career. Bergman died on 25 September 2024, at the age of 61.
